I can't confirm that for the full period. No detections intersected ASSET-F14 between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12, but coverage was not complete.

VIIRS S-NPP has a gap from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06, because the FIRMS area API did not provide data for those days. Under the run's rule, every day must be covered by each sensor for that sensor to count as covered, so S-NPP does not qualify for the full period.

VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21 and MODIS covered the whole period and found nothing at the asset. That makes a missed detection less likely, but it doesn't meet the full-coverage standard for every sensor.

A safe statement is: "No thermal detections were found at the asset in the period, though VIIRS S-NPP data was missing for 2–6 November." To close the gap, you could re-run once S-NPP data for those days becomes available.
